errors.name: AmountOverflow
errors.description: The sum of the amounts does not fit in the type of the amounts.

errors.name: LengthMismatch
errors.description: There is not exactly one amount for every recipient.

errors.name: NoRecipients
errors.description: The list of recipients is empty.

errors.name: WrongAttachedValue
errors.description: The CSPR attached to the call is not the sum of the amounts.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.description: One of the amounts is zero.

entry_points.name: send_cspr
entry_points.description: Sends `amounts[i]` motes of CSPR to `recipients[i]`. The CSPR attached to the call must be exactly the sum of the amounts.

entry_points.name: send_token
entry_points.description: Sends `amounts[i]` of the CEP-18 `token` from the caller to `recipients[i]`. The caller must have approved this contract for at least the sum of the amounts. The tokens go straight from the caller to each recipient; the contract never holds them.

arguments.name: odra_cfg_package_hash_key_name
arguments.description: The arg name for the package hash key name.

arguments.name: odra_cfg_allow_key_override
arguments.description: If true and the key specified in odra_cfg_package_hash_key_name already exists, it will be overwritten.

arguments.name: odra_cfg_is_upgradable
arguments.description: The arg name for the contract upgradeability setting.

arguments.name: odra_cfg_is_upgrade
arguments.description: The arg name for telling the installer that the contract is being upgraded.
